title: Entropy & Information Content
interviewAnswer: Entropy measures average uncertainty in a distribution: concentrated distributions have low entropy; balanced, unpredictable distributions have higher entropy.
why: Entropy is the language behind cross-entropy, decision trees, compression and language-model uncertainty.
intuition: A fair coin is harder to predict than a coin that is heads 99% of the time, so it carries more uncertainty per observation.
deepDive: For a discrete variable, entropy is expected negative log-probability. The logarithm makes information from independent events additive. Differential entropy for continuous variables has different interpretation and can be negative.
commonMistakes: Assuming continuous differential entropy behaves exactly like discrete entropy.
followUps: How is entropy related to compression?
production: Use entropy as an uncertainty summary, but operational decisions still need calibrated probabilities and task costs.
workedExample: A fair binary variable has 1 bit of entropy; a 99/1 variable has much less.

visual.title: Entropy rises with uncertainty
visual.caption: Entropy is highest when outcomes are balanced and falls as one outcome becomes predictable.
